contact.subheading: Write to us — we will get back to you within 24 hours and set your first step together.

hero_subheadline: It's not just about muscles. It's about life.
hero_paragraph_1: I help people gain more energy, improve their health, build a stronger body, and develop habits that allow them to live a better life.
hero_paragraph_2: I am not a trainer for everyone. My goal is not for you to live for the gym. My goal is for you to have more energy for your family, better focus at work, more confidence, less pain, and more joy every day.
hero_paragraph_3: That is why at La Bella Vita you don't just get a training plan. You get individual coaching, personalised nutrition, Visbody measurements, support, community, and a system that helps you feel better — physically and mentally.
hero_paragraph_4: Because the greatest luxury is not a perfect physique. The greatest luxury is having health, energy, and the freedom to enjoy life fully.
whatis_line_1: Most people don't just want a better body.
whatis_line_4: They want to wake up in the morning without exhaustion.
whatis_line_5: They want to feel good in their own body.
whatis_line_6: They want to be a better partner, parent, or leader.
whatis_line_7: They want the strength to do the things they love.
whatis_highlight: That is exactly why La Bella Vita was created.
whatis_subline_1: It is not a fitness programme.
whatis_subline_2: It is a path to a better quality of life.
whatis_closing: We believe health is not one priority among many. It is the foundation on which everything else stands.
quote_text: Health is not everything. But without health, everything is nothing.
pillars_tagline: A beautiful life is built on four foundations. Each one is essential.
pillar_movement_body: From a scientific perspective we know that regular movement significantly influences hormonal balance, reduces stress, and improves overall quality of life. Movement is therefore not a punishment but a fundamental human need. It is the gateway to La Bella Vita — the beautiful life.
pillar_nutrition_body_1: Nutrition is not about extremes, starvation, or endless calorie counting. It is about quality, balance, and long-term sustainable habits that support your health, energy, and results.
pillar_nutrition_body_2: We set nutrition individually for each client according to their goal, lifestyle, and preferences. They can choose between a personalised nutrition plan with delicious and simple recipes, or the EasyDiet service, where quality meals are prepared and delivered directly to their door.
pillar_nutrition_body_3: Because a beautiful life should not be about deprivation. It should taste good.
pillar_community_body: No one has to walk this path alone. La Bella Vita is a community of people who have decided to invest in their health, growth, and quality of life. We train together. We play sport together. We celebrate small and big victories together.
pillar_mindset_body: Results do not happen in a single day. They come from the decisions we make every day. Discipline is not a restriction. It is a form of freedom. The better you take care of yourself, the more you can give to the world around you.
mystory_line_1: I was not always a trainer.
mystory_line_2: I was someone who struggled with their weight from a young age.
mystory_line_3: Later I went through a period that changed my life forever.
mystory_line_4: The loss of my father taught me how fragile physical and mental health can be.
mystory_line_5: It was then that movement became something more than just training. It became a support. It helped me find direction. It helped me find myself.
mystory_line_6: And today my mission is to help people build a life in which they feel strong, healthy, and content.
mystory_line_7: Not just for a few weeks. For life.
coaching_intro_2: That is why we do not create generic plans.
coaching_intro_3: Together we will set a strategy that respects your lifestyle, goals, possibilities, and pace.
online_headline: Your plan. Anywhere in the world.
online_intro: With the Trainerize app you have everything in one place.
online_body: Modern coaching that allows you to achieve results no matter where you are.
transform_intro: We don't focus only on the number on the scale. We track energy. Health. Performance. Movement. Confidence.
transform_visbody_body: Visbody gives us a detailed view of your body composition: body fat percentage, muscle mass, visceral fat, muscle distribution between left and right, postural deviations, and the overall development of your physique. Combined with regular check-ins and individual guidance, you get a clear picture of what is really happening in your body and what progress you are making on your journey to La Bella Vita.
transform_1_story: After my second child I felt lost in my own body. Alessandro helped me find myself again — not just physically but above all mentally. In eight months I achieved results I thought would never be possible again.
transform_2_story: I work in a corporate office, sitting eight hours a day. My spine was sending signals that this could not go on. With Alessandro we built a plan around my packed schedule. Today I have the strength and energy I had at twenty-five.
transform_3_story: I was never a 'sporty type'. La Bella Vita showed me that movement doesn't have to be aggressive or stressful. Now I genuinely look forward to every session and the results speak for themselves.
cta1_line: Maybe today is the day you begin.
food_body_1: I collaborate with EasyDiet, which shares my nutrition philosophy. Quality, delicious, and healthy meals — prepared and delivered directly to your door.
food_body_2: No forbidden foods. No counting calories down to the last gram. Instead, simple and sustainable eating that supports your results and gives you more energy every day.
financing_body: We believe health care should never be a question of finances. That is why we offer a flexible, zero-interest instalment plan — spread your investment in your own health into comfortable monthly payments and start without stress.
community_tagline: A beautiful life is lived better together.
community_body: Running Club. Volleyball tournaments. Group breakfasts. Workshops. Community events. We are building an environment where a healthy lifestyle is not an obligation. It is a natural part of life.
cta2_line: Your best year starts with one step.
corporate_body: A company's performance reflects the health of the people who make it. We help companies create an environment where employees have more energy, less stress, and a better quality of life.
corporate_item_4: Visbody analyses for the whole team
corporate_item_6: La Bella Vita philosophy directly in your company
instagram_tagline: Daily inspiration, movement, and beautiful life — straight to your feed.
review_1_text: Alessandro is an incredible trainer. In 3 months I lost 12 kg and feel better than ever. His approach is motivating and completely professional.
review_2_text: I always thought a personal trainer was a luxury. After working with Alessandro I know it is an investment that pays for itself. The results speak for themselves.
review_3_text: La Bella Vita changed my view of fitness. Alessandro is not just a trainer — he is a mentor who genuinely cares about you as a whole person.
finalcta_line_2: It is a gift that deserves your attention every day.
contact_success: Thank you! We will be in touch soon.
